sentence_stem: Yesterday I cleaned my room, so
full_sentence: Yesterday I cleaned my room, so it looked very clean.

options.why_wrong: This describes another cleaning action, but 'so' needs a result of cleaning the room.
This states a different intention and does not follow as a result of cleaning the room.

options.text: I forgot my keys at home.
options.why_wrong: This event has no logical connection to cleaning the room.

grammar_focus: Past simple of regular verbs (cleaned) with 'so' to show a result
explanation: After 'so', we need a result clause that follows logically from the first part of the sentence. Portuguese speakers may forget that regular past verbs in English add -ed, so check the verb ending in the first clause.
translation: Ontem limpei meu quarto, então ele ficou muito limpo.
